name: Let's Felt! Jack-o-lanterns
label: Hands-on workshop
description:
Show off your Halloween spirit, in this Let's Felt! workshop. Using colorful wool and needle felting techniques you'll create your own flat, 2D pumpkin, and then give it a jack-o-lantern face all its own!
We'll start by felting our pumpkins, and then have fun deciding how you want to “carve” it. Will it be more spooky or more silly? It is completely up to you! No previous needle felting experience is necessary. All materials and tools are provided, and you'll leave with a woolly jack-o-lantern ready to welcome fall.
